comparison.objective: Trace a leaking coolant branch through crossing lines and close only its valve; candidate tunes and locks a robot-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual pipe tracing and contact-driven valve-lever actuation versus recessed hex-key alignment, bimanual counterholding, collar adjustment, locking, and guarded impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Stop the correct spray without testing or closing wrong valves; exact lever-angle and wetness thresholds are not given. Candidate requires two bounded stopping cycles with explicit safety and retention gates.
comparison.reason: Diagnostic branch tracing and selective shutoff do not test dynamic parameter commissioning or fastener-retained adjustment.
